note: At 2:55 (the last 5 s of w6 into w7) the guitarists come together for one four-cell phrase and four cells of the negative; the melody returns twice as fast, then at its original pace. The last beat is left free for the cadence.

1:32.5–2:00: the bass anticipates the three missing pitches at the end of each third cell. The clean chord shortens as the phrase fills; at 1:53.125 the bass gets its first complete E♭–C–A♭–F without another attack. No faders moved.

At 0:16.875 the right hand answers the travelling eleven-tick line on the opening’s stationary beat four; its six upper fifths ring through E♭ and C, then both guitars meet again on low F at 0:30.208. The ring intro and the first three heavy cells are unchanged.
2:13.75–2:27.5: on A♭ the right guitar rings across the four gaps. It echoes the struck tune three times, then anticipates the next pitch.
v11: 0:37.5-1:00.4 in the cell where each note is handed to the ring its gap is left empty (0.42, 0.62, 0.21, 0.21 s) before the muted strokes arrive; the first hole is the handover downbeat.

v12: 1:11.9–1:25.6, each gap of the negative takes the scale note between the two missing notes around it (D flat, B flat, G, and F where nothing lies between): bass alone, then with the left guitar, then both, the last cell with the snare on the four holes. Then the cell with no band, and F again. The wiw-negative excerpt at 1:05–1:11.9 is untouched.
